candidates.instruction: Replace the top’s `counter8_core` instance with a top-level 8-bit registered counter, keeping the existing ports and `// @latency 1` annotation. Use synchronous reset with priority, and otherwise toggle bit 0 on `enable` and each higher bit when `enable` and all lower bits are one; hold the count when disabled. Preserve modulo-256 wraparound and registered outputs, and do not add registers or alter observable cycles.
